2026So Far: Six and Oh, and He Still Hasn't Touched the Waiver WireIn progress · 3 weeks in · Birdgangflyeagles 6-0, dahlilama 5-1

Three weeks in, one team is still unbeaten, one juror dropped the third-highest score in league history, and one record streak just got longer. The evidence so far.

6-0Birdgangflyeagles, zero moves
175.08Goldminers1's Week 3, 3rd-best ever
11straight H2H wins for juleon8
52transactions so far

The quiet man is 6-0

Birdgangflyeagles still hasn't made a single move this season: no trades, no waivers, no free agents. He's 6-0 anyway, with the fewest points against in the league (241). In Week 3 he handed Bjspjs4 his first head-to-head loss, 120.64–72.46. Last year he went 3-11. The jury remains unable to explain any of this.

dahlilama leads the league in points

dahlilama is 5-1, 3-0 head-to-head, and now leads the league with 406 points after a 154.30 in Week 3 against Sleon1000. He's also the new futures favorite at +200. His only loss so far is to the league median.

Goldminers1 goes nuclear

Goldminers1 put up 175.08 in Week 3, the third-highest score in league history, and beat rbanuelos3 by 80.56, the fourth-biggest blowout ever. That also ended rbanuelos3's 8-game head-to-head win streak. Goldminers1 is now 3-3 and second in the league in points (398), which is a fun sentence for the manager who owns the record for weekly low scores.

The streak lives: 11 straight

juleon8 beat kevinnguu 86.64–69.76 and stretched his league-record head-to-head winning streak to 11 straight, dating back to Week 7 of 2025. It wasn't pretty: 86.64 was below the week's median, so he also took the median loss and sits at 3-3. A win is a win. Half a win is also a win, apparently.

Also in the file

  • giJ03 got his first career win, 124.30–92.38 over showmeyourtd23, one week after a 55.74 that still sits third-lowest in league history.
  • elysianbeer beat MayockJr 98.00–76.38 and is quietly 4-2.
  • Sleon1000, showmeyourtd23 and kevinnguu are all 0-3 head-to-head. Sleon1000 is 2-4 overall; the other two are 1-5.
  • No new trades since Bjspjs4's three-deal Week 2. MayockJr leads the league with 14 moves.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. Off to a 5-1 start and leads the league at 135.4 points a week.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 6-0 without making a single move, with the league's fewest points against. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and his 8-game head-to-head win streak just ended.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs and 2-4 this year.
cases.juleon8: Riding a league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 144.08 in Week 2. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also just dropped 175.08, the third-best score ever.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.Bjspjs4: 4-2 with three trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut. Nobody has film on him.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 2-4, with a first win (124.30) one week after a 55.74. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
